actions.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Water, Wildlife and Fisheries.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts residents, commercial fisheries, and energy lessees operating off the coasts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama.
dimensions.evidence: delegating management of the submerged lands from 3 geographical miles to 3 marine leagues

dimensions.assessment: Transfers regulatory authority, lease management, and revenue collection powers over expanded offshore areas to state governments.
dimensions.evidence: a State to which authority is delegated under this section may collect rentals, royalties, and other sums

dimensions.assessment: Alters the disposition of federal and state revenues by allowing qualifying states to collect rentals and royalties on new leases in the expanded area.
dimensions.evidence: Section 9 of this Act and section 105 of the Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act of 2006 shall not apply with respect to a lease granted after the date of enactment

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act and the Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act and the Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change in jurisdictional boundaries and management authority for the specified Gulf states upon request within a 5-year window.
dimensions.evidence: Upon written request of a State before the date that is 5 years after the date of enactment of the Offshore Parity Act of 2026

missing_information: Exact monetary projections of shifted oil and gas royalty revenues between federal and state treasuries
importance_detail.rationale: Delegates management of expanded submerged lands (from 3 geographical miles to 3 marine leagues) for oil, gas, energy, and fisheries to Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama upon request.

selection.reason: Impact scored by Gemini. (rated before the current eligibility rules; kept)
